with P0..P4 the qwords at `+0`, `+8`, `+0x10`, `+0x18`, `+0x20` of qword `rdx+0x10`, i the sign-extended `r9d`, set/clear meaning OR 1/AND 0xfffffffe on a Pk's dword `+8`, and S(x) storing the result of the function called at `0023CAF0+0x46` (also at `+0xAE` and `+0x126`) on x at qword `R+0x18` and `0020E620(0)` at dword `R+0x20`: when dword `rcx+0xc8` is 0, R = P4, S(i + 0x53f), then it clears P0, P1, P3 and P2 and sets P4; otherwise R = P3, S(the call at `0023CAF0+0x3F` on dword `rcx+0xd0+i*4`), sets P3 and clears P4, then when dword `rcx+0xe8` equals i it sets P0, clears P1 and P2 and, when dword `rcx+0xec` is non-zero, does S(0x46dd); else when dwords `rcx+0xdc+i*4` and `rcx+0xd0+i*4` differ it sets P2 and clears P1 and P0, and when they are equal sets P1 and clears P0 and P2; every path ends with `0029FAD0(R)` and returns 1

when `edx` is 0 it only clears bit 0x20 of byte `rcx+0xc`; otherwise, when byte `rcx+0x18` is not 1 and word `rcx+0xd2` is 0xffff, it takes the low 32 bits of `0020E600(dword +0x18 of qword rcx+0x40)` as an offset R from the qword at `02098E10` + byte `rcx+0x15` * 0x288 and loops forever (a `jmp` to itself) when the signed word at R is 5 or less or the signed word at R+0xc is negative; then, when byte `rcx+0x18` is not 1 and word `rcx+0xd0` is 0xffff, it calls `0020E600` on that same dword and discards the result; finally it sets bit 0x20 of byte `rcx+0xc`

calls `00263FF0(0)`, then the function at `00357170+0x10` with no argument loaded, and when that returns anything other than 2 ORs 4 into byte `+0x17` of the `00263FF0` result; returns the second call's `eax`
